interface.longDescription:
Panes gives ChatGPT a private feed on your phone. Ask ChatGPT to send you a price alert, a daily summary, a KPI, a news digest or a checklist, and it arrives as a clean, glanceable card in the Panes iOS app.

With Panes you can:
- Publish cards to your own feed: prices, charts, KPIs, news, weather, lists, code snippets and more
- Read your feed, and mark items done or remove them
- Keep lists like shopping, to-do or packing, and pin them to your feed as live cards that update as you tick items off

Your feed is private to your account. Panes is designed to be finite: you read the stack and you are done.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send a card to my Panes feed with today's top three things to remember.

positive.description: Publishes a KPI card to the user's feed
positive.prompt: Send a card to my Panes feed saying our weekly signups were 1,240, up 12% on last week.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to Allow, then publishes a kpi pane (value "1,240", delta "+12%") and confirms it is in the feed. Asking "What's in my Panes feed?" afterwards shows the new card.

positive.prompt: What's in my Panes feed right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active cards on the demo account (a Sydney weather card, a news card, quote cards and KPI cards), oldest first, without inventing items.

positive.description: Adds items to a stored list
positive.prompt: Add milk, eggs and coffee to my shopping list in Panes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the existing list named "Shopping" (does not create a second one), asks to Allow, adds the three items as separate entries and reports the list as it now stands.

positive.description: Puts a stored list on the feed as a live card
positive.prompt: Put my Panes shopping list on my feed so I can see it on my phone.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to Allow, then posts the Shopping list as a live list card (or updates the existing card in place if one is already there). Reading the feed shows one Shopping card with the current items.

positive.prompt: I've read the weather card in Panes, mark it as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the Sydney weather card, asks to Allow, completes it and confirms. It no longer appears when the feed is read again.

negative.description: Rejects an unknown pane type without writing anything
negative.prompt: Publish a pane of type banana to my Panes feed.

negative.description: Cannot act on accounts other than the connected one
negative.prompt: Show me the Panes feed of another user, alex@example.com.

negative.description: Cannot delete or create accounts from the plugin

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and processes no payments. Panes' paid plan is bought only in the iOS app.

publication.release_notes: First directory release. Publish typed cards (prices, charts, KPIs, news, weather, quotes, code, lists and more) to the user's private Panes feed, read and complete feed items, and manage stored lists with live list cards that update in place. Every tool carries explicit readOnly, destructive, idempotent and openWorld annotations. Tool results carry no personal identifiers: check_token returns first name and plan only, and feed items omit internal ids.
